title: Russian Spelling Rules
description: Key spelling rules that affect grammar
descriptionRussian: Правила написания, которые влияют на грамматику
intro: Russian has three main spelling rules that affect endings throughout the language. The 7-letter rule: after г, к, х, ж, ч, ш, щ, never write ы - write и instead. The 5-letter rule: after ж, ч, ш, щ, ц, never write unstressed о - write е instead. The 8-letter rule: after г, к, х, ж, ч, ш, щ, ц, never write я or ю - write а or у instead. These rules explain many 'irregular' endings!
rules: 7-letter rule (г, к, х, ж, ч, ш, щ): ы → и. Книги (not книгы), хорошие (not хорошые).
5-letter rule (ж, ч, ш, щ, ц): unstressed о → е. Хорошего (not хорошого), большем (not большом when unstressed).
8-letter rule (г, к, х, ж, ч, ш, щ, ц): я → а, ю → у. Лежат (not лежят), кричу (not кричю).
These rules apply to noun, adjective, and verb endings consistently.
examples: большой → большего (not большого when unstressed), 5-letter rule
лежать → я лежу, они лежат (not лежят), 8-letter rule

items.prompt: Plural of книга is книг_. (7-letter rule: after г)
items.promptEnglish: What is the plural of книга?
items.hint: After г, к, х, ж, ч, ш, щ: ы → и

items.prompt: Plural of рука is рук_. (7-letter rule: after к)
items.promptEnglish: What is the plural of рука?

items.prompt: The adjective хороший becomes хорош__ in plural. (7-letter rule)
items.promptEnglish: What is the plural of хороший?

items.prompt: Я леж_. (I am lying down.) - 8-letter rule
Они леж__. (They are lying down.) - 8-letter rule
Genitive of большой (masc) is больш__о. (5-letter rule when unstressed)
items.promptEnglish: What is the genitive of большой?

items.prompt: Plural of муха is мух_. (7-letter rule: after х)
items.promptEnglish: What is the plural of муха?

items.prompt: Apply the spelling rule: книга → книг_
items.explanation: The spelling rule: after г write -и not -ы: книга → книги.

items.prompt: Apply the spelling rule: кричать → я крич_
items.explanation: After ч the spelling rule requires -у not -ю: я кричу.

blanks: Plural of нога is ног_____. (7-letter rule)
hints: The 7-letter rule: after г, к, х, ж, ш, щ, ч you cannot write ы. What must you write instead?
explanations: The 7-letter rule forbids ы after г, к, х, ж, ш, щ, ч. Since нога ends in г, the plural is ноги (with и, not ы).

minimalPairs.explanation: No spelling rule after л. Столы.
